svg.text: Isolated flyback DC/DC with Si886xx – AN901 Figure 1.1, values from Design Example 1
24 V in → 5 V / 1 A out (isolated), 500 kHz, CCM, 3:1 flyback transformer. Component values: AN901 Table 4.2 (ordering guide). Optional circuits in dashed boxes.
Si886xx: isolated dc-dc controller + 2 digital channels (SO-20 WB)
optional soft start and frequency control (Si886xx)
Q2 / R14 / C14: linear pre-regulator that powers VDDA from VIN (needed when VIN exceeds the VDDA range).
Q3 / R18 / R19 / D8 / R17: keep Q1 off when the converter is shut down (SHDN high); D8 speeds up turn-off.
R13 / C6 (Si886xx only): switching frequency 500 kHz (R13 = 1025.5 × Tsw) and soft start; C6 is 470 nF in the text (Table 4.2 lists 0.4 µF).
R5 / R6: VOUT = 1.05 V × (1 + R5 / R6) ≈ 4.99 V. R7 / C11: compensation (R7 fixed at 100 kΩ for Si884xx/6xx).
Source: Skyworks AN901 Rev. 0.5 (public application note), Figure 1.1 and Design Example 1. Redrawn for discussion – not a verified design.
